kernels.label: Demo image mean score
kernels.description: Teaching scalar: mean intensity after RGB float normalize.

kernels.label: Demo center ROI mean
kernels.description: Mean intensity over the center-half ROI.

kernels.label: ROI centroid (center half)
kernels.description: Unweighted geometric centroid in the center-half ROI; mask is median_bg + 5% of (peak−bg), plus full-frame peak for presence.

kernels.label: Beam power features
kernels.description: Power proxy; saturation channel mandatory for closed loop.

kernels.label: Gaussian beam moments
kernels.description: Unweighted mask moments (median_bg + 5% of peak−bg): amplitude, geometric centroid, and spatial widths.

kernels.label: Beam shift from FOV center
kernels.description: Unweighted geometric-centroid offset from this frame's center (W/2, H/2) as [dx, dy, magnitude] in px — resolution-agnostic, no reference capture. Maximize shift with weight=-1 on minimize_value(feature_index=2).

kernels.label: Beam CoM (full frame)
kernels.description: Full-frame unweighted geometric centroid of the brightest ~0.5% of pixels (faint-beam safe) as [cx, cy, peak]. Use with signed_axis_offset vs origin / axis / direction.
